title: Exterior powers commute with module stalks
statement: For a scheme X [def-pc-scheme], a module sheaf M and n≥0, form its exterior sheaf [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power]. For every x in X, there is an O_{X,x}-linear equivalence (exteriorSheaf M n)_x ≃ exteriorPower n M_x, using stalks [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. For every neighborhood U of x and tuple a in M(U), it sends the germ of exteriorSheafSection M n U a to the wedge of the germs of the entries of a.

proof.text: Use Mathlib exteriorPower.presentation to present exterior powers by finite tuples, coordinate additivity and scalar relations, and vanishing on repeated entries. Represent every finite tuple and scalar of stalk elements on a common neighborhood. Wedges of representatives define an inverse map: changing representatives is harmless after restricting to a neighborhood where all entry germs agree. Each finite relation is realized after further restriction, so the map factors through the exterior presentation. The two maps are inverse on wedge generators, hence on their spans.

The sheafification unit induces an isomorphism of additive stalks by lem-weil-pbc-stalk-sheafification-space. Represent a scalar and a section on a common neighborhood and apply the germ scalar formula to see this isomorphism is linear. Compose its inverse with the previous comparison. On wedge germs this gives exactly the stated formula. Empty tuples for n=0 and zero stalk rings require no exclusion.

lean.statement:
theorem exteriorSheaf_stalk_comparison {X : Scheme.{v}} (M : X.Modules)
    (n : ℕ) (x : X) :
    ∃ e : (exteriorSheaf M n).presheaf.stalk x ≃ₗ[X.presheaf.stalk x]
        ⋀[X.presheaf.stalk x]^n (M.presheaf.stalk x),
      ∀ (U : X.Opens) (hx : x ∈ U) (a : Fin n → M.val.obj (op U)),
        e ((exteriorSheaf M n).presheaf.germ U x hx (exteriorSheafSection M n U a)) =
          exteriorPower.ιMulti (X.presheaf.stalk x) n
            (fun i ↦ M.presheaf.germ U x hx (a i))
